title: client-pulse project file
description: One YAML/JSON object per client project. Unknown properties are rejected by the CLI loader.

name.description: Project title. Must be unique across files (case-insensitive).

status.description: done projects are excluded from overdue, blockers and over-estimate checks.

deadline.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD. A project due today is not overdue.

next_milestone.description: Optional short label for the next checkpoint.

blockers.description: Optional open blockers. Ignored when status is done.
